create_bitbucket_prompt_manager: create a BitBucket prompt manager that loads .prompt templates from a BitBucket repository for use with LiteLLM
get_bitbucket_prompt_template: get a rendered prompt template and its metadata from a BitBucket .prompt file by ID
run_bitbucket_pre_call_hook: run the BitBucket pre-call hook to process a prompt template and extract model parameters before an LLM call
build_bitbucket_template_manager: build a BitBucket template manager that loads, parses, and renders .prompt files with Jinja2 templating
list_bitbucket_available_prompts: list all available prompt template IDs loaded from a BitBucket repository
